title: Output Schema for PGP Sign and Encrypt Operation
description: Output schema for the cryptography pgpSignAndEncrypt operation.

payload.description: The signed-then-encrypted message: ASCII-armored text (armor=true) or base64 of the binary message (armor=false). Present in the response variable when overwriteBody is false; when overwriteBody is true the message is written to the message body instead (raw application/octet-stream when armor=false).

headers.description: Transport headers associated with the response.
